# Check of M0-c-03 — S4 Backbone (lane `check/M0-c-03`, flow flow-7, stage group 12, 2026-10-06)

Lane `check/M0-c-03`. This seat is Opus 5.5 in Claude Code on the owner's Windows PC. The machine check
(`python3 tools/machine_profile.py --id`) printed `wsl:Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-10900K CPU @ 3.70GHz:20cpu:16gib`, and
`node --version` printed `v24.12.0`. The seat is the item's implementer-side independent checker. It is not the item's
author (`build/M0-c-03`, L-0252). Protocol: `M0.md` §3 steps 1–5, J180 (blocker or minor), N-45 / J202 (fail safe now,
harden later), J193 (relative locality).

The seat ran no git command and changed none of the item's files. Disclosure: its first grep of the lane log for the
item's key also printed the author's CHECKPOINT and LANDED lines, which name some of its self-check mutants by number
and list three parts it did not reach. That happened before this seat planned its probes. The seat did not open any
`selfcheck-*` folder. It planned its own probes (P1–P11) and its own 36 targeted mutants (X01–X37, no X34) from the
brief, C-0236 and the code, and it judged each survivor itself. Probes and mutants ran in its own mirrors under
`~/maps-scratch/waves/check-M0-c-03/` (`m1/`–`m3/`, copies of `plat/`, each with its own install). Mutants ran one per
mirror with `--maxWorkers=1`, three at once (`test_budget.py --mutants` printed 3). The folder keeps `mutants.py`,
`related_mut.py`, `dump.sh`, the probe sources and every log (`logs/`). The mirrors' `node_modules` are deleted.

## Verdict: FAIL — five blockers, all of one kind: a record or measure the item states, which no test pins

Every gate is green, and the item's here-bars hold on the 12 CITY seeds this seat ran. Thirty of the 36 targeted
mutants are killed. Six survive the item's own tests and the related set at 1 000. Five of the six change a committed
record or a report the item states, on the item's own fixture (non-equivalence shown by record dumps on CITY seeds
1–3). Each of those five is a blocker under J180: "a surviving targeted mutant on a stated promise or interface
contract". The sixth (X29) is a note. Each fix is one or two assertions; no code change is required unless the new
test finds a real defect. The minor notes are in `checks/M0-c-03-notes.md` (8 notes, for M4).

## Mutants (targeted, 36): 30 killed, 6 survive near and related

Killed by the near set (failing test named in `logs/run-m*.txt`):

* graph: X01 (the merge at exactly 8 m), X02 (no split at pins), X03 (merge into a gate), X25 (no loop cut), X35 (a
  pinned node merged away), X23 (the parallel fold off: §13.2 fails on seeds 1 and 3);
* classify: X04 (no promotion), X05 (the width formula), X06 (Brandes counts non-targets), X32 (the lowest class kept);
* junctions: X07 (Y→T never applied), X08 (no deflection), X36 (Y→T ignores the radius);
* smooth: X09 (one Chaikin pass, caught by §13.2 seed 3), X10 (no curvature limit, caught by the validation test);
* commit: X12 (no width profile), X14 (the bridge stays a site), X15 (no `Gate.way`), X24 (no validation fallback),
  X26 (shared chains claimed twice), X30 (one lineage index for every way);
* stage: X16 (no frame extension), X17 (no held corridor), X18 (the inward part routed `through`);
* route: X19 (the approach always usable), X20 (no band check), X21 (the slope rung skips `primary`), X22 (the work
  limit off by one), X27 (the deck entry and exit swapped), X37 (excluded decks passable).

Surviving, near 62/62 and related at 1 000 355/355 (`logs/rel-m*.txt`): X11 (B-1), X33 (B-2), X31 (B-3), X28 (B-4),
X13 (B-5) and X29 (`stage.ts:204`: an outward part meeting the wall off its gate is not counted). X29 changes
`report.offGate`. The count is 0 on every fixture, and the bar it serves ("every route committed through its gate") is
asserted directly from the arena (way–wall shared vertices = the gate points). So X29 is off the stated promises and is
note 1.

## Fail-safety (N-45)

No probe threw on valid input. Twelve CITY seeds, six small sites and four walled-area variants all committed without
refusal, and determinism holds (`backbone.test.ts`'s second run, and the reversed-op arena). The five blockers are
unpinned records, not observed wrong results: on every fixture this seat dumped, the knots, the way classes, the
bearings and the T/Y kinds are right. They are blockers because nothing would catch a regression in them.
